newsitem.title: CHINA: China tests personal handyphone system - official.
newsitem.headline: China tests personal handyphone system - official.

text.p: China has begun testing use of Japan's personal handyphone system (PHS) as well as a European system to expand its wireless telecommunications, an official of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications said on Thursday.
The systems would be in test use until the second half of this year before a final decision on permanent introduction of the systems would be made, the official said.
The personal handyphone system, as well as Europe's digital enhanced cordless telecommunications (DECT), were in trial use, he said.

He denied a report in Japan's Nihon Keizai Shimbun that quoted Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Ministry as saying the Chinese government had allocated frequency bands for PHS, allowing for the introduction of the system in areas where telecommunications facilities were not yet available, calling it premature.
The decision may boost output of related equipment and products in China and also increase imports from Japan, the newspaper said on Thursday.
PHS, which was developed in Japan, is cheaper to use than cellular phones and has a greater range than cordless phones, but cannot be used in moving vehicles.
